title: 第5章 ?弃若敝履
content_zh:
第5章弃若敝履
秦诚愕然，他花了很长时间，消耗大量精力，通过家里的关系才探听出一些秘闻。
可现在王煊通过自己的观察，就已经推测出更多的东西，怀疑另有一条触及超自然力量的路。
“所以，旧术就这样被撇弃了？！”秦诚非常不甘心。
在探听到那些秘闻时，他心中还很激动，认为终于洞彻真相，研究旧术是为了触及超自然力量。
也是在那一刻，他坚定了信念，从此要开始认真钻研旧术，在这条路上克服一切困难走下去。
可现在却听闻，想接近超自然力量，似是另有一条路，这顿时给他刚火热起来的心泼了一盆冷水。
好半天秦诚才回过神来，有些受打击。
新星究竟发现了什么，除却神秘现象外，还找到了一条真正可以通向超凡的路？
显然，如果为真，这将会引发无法想象的冲击，有观念上的，更有现实世界的某些变革。
秦诚严肃而认真：“眼下，前往新星的机会越发显得珍贵，如果可以触及超自然力量，走在最前沿，凡你所想，皆有可能！”
两人一边聊，一边吃早饭。
“从深空运过来的特殊食物，真是吃一顿少一顿了，当初还觉得口感糟糕，现在却有些不舍了。”
两人颇为感慨。
虽然这些食材非常稀珍，昂贵的吓死人，但是各种食材搭配在一起后，味道确实不怎么样。
秦诚询问王煊，有没有去找教导他们旧术的老教授聊一聊，看有没有办法解决去新星的问题。
王煊摇头，老教授虽然很喜欢他，但却没有那么大的权利，在这个旧术研究项目中，只是被请来传授旧术，其他都没有参与。
“他们选人到底什么标准？”秦诚不满，觉得对王煊很不公平。
王煊想了想，道：“我估计应该是与敏锐的心灵、释放远超常人的潜能等有关，总之就是稍微触及了神秘领域。”
他曾看过第一批被选中的名单，做出这种推断。

比如，班中有一对双胞胎姐妹，彼此间经常有莫名感应，妹妹意外受到惊吓，姐姐也会同时心悸。
而有一次，姐姐削苹果时在手指上留下一道很深的血口子，当时妹妹有事在另外一座城市，虽然相隔很远，但相应的手指也跟着作痛。
这种现象无从解释。
这次挑选实验班的学生时，她们两人在第一时间被选中。
“那何清是怎么回事？”秦诚不解地问道。
在他的印象中，实验班中的何清内向淳朴，平日不怎么爱说话。
据悉，当初何清对旧术并不感兴趣，听说毕业后可以保证一份得体且薪资很高的工作，他才报名。
所以秦诚有点想不明白，何清明显有抵触情绪，怎么最后还会被选中？
“在何清身上曾发生过一件事儿，他十四岁那年，曾目睹他的弟弟即将被飞驰过的汽车撞上，他奋不顾身地冲了过去，猛力推开他的弟弟，自己却被汽车从身上辗轧过去，但是，他并没有受伤，只是在身上留下被轮胎辗轧过的乌黑痕迹。”
当时所有人都震惊，有些想不通，最后只能认为他在生死关头爆发出人体的某种神秘潜能。
旧术研究项目的投资方，将何清少年时期的这件事挖掘出来调查过，可见对他们了解有多深。
第一批被选中的人都有各自的特殊之处，比如有位女生感知超常，最出名的一次经历是，有次登机前她心慌的不得了，以为自己病了，心脏出了问题，吓得临时跑去就医。
结果，当日她错过的那架飞机竟失事了。
“这都能行？我们班上还有这样的怪物！”秦诚目瞪口呆，在这之前没听说过这件事。
王煊也有些感慨，他第一次听到时也一阵出神，但也就这个女生最为特殊，其他的人与事都勉强可以接受。
当日，被选中前往新星的名单最终确认，果然没有再添新人。
实验班中有一部分人留下来，一直没有放弃，等待最后的机会，现在结果揭晓，他们无比失落。
一些人虽然早有预感，但心中还是非常难受。
王煊很平静，对于这个结果早就预料到了。
秦诚叹气，为好友惋惜，将旧术真正练出名堂，可却被放弃了，只因深空尽头的超自然力量露出冰山一角，另一条路出现了！

新星那边选择超凡，正式放弃旧术！
秦诚与王煊聊了很多，谈到班中提前离去的几位好友，两人一阵怅然。
王煊还好，留在旧土，与那几人还能再聚。
秦诚问他：“你不去和女友见一见？她就要返回新星了，再不去就真的没机会了，以后恐怕再难见到了。”
王煊摇了摇头：“都分开一年多了，我就不去送她了，免得她家人知道又多想，给她造成困扰，各自安好吧。”
秦诚叹气，有一位来自新星的前女友，当初对王煊来说也是各种压力，那女生的家人相当强势，直接来旧土警告过数次。
“你这次没被选中，会不会是她家里人出力了，要压住你，不让你去新星？”秦诚忽然想到这种可能。
因为，王煊前女友家里很不一般。
尽管现在旧术被放弃了。
但现在回过头来看，早期有些人将子女从新星送来学旧术，明显是在为接触超自然力量做准备，肯定有些背景。
“不会！”虽然接触次数有限，但王煊了解她家里人的性格，不至于如此，再说都分开一年多了，彼此间没有了交集。
此外，旧术研究项目背后是一些财阀，没有人敢随便乱动手脚。
夜幕降临，繁星点点，两人无话不谈。
“再过几天我就要去新月了。王煊，我心里有些矛盾，真的希望你有机会前往新星，可以接触到超自然力量，踏上那条新路。但我又觉得，他们将旧术随手扔掉，弃之如敝履，很过分，我们都被抛弃了！”
说到这里，秦诚平复了一下情绪，再次开口：“所以，我又有些希望你在旧术这条路上能有大成就，如果那些神话传说是真的该有多好，有一天你可以凭借旧术对抗超自然力量，能压制新星那边超凡领域的生灵，让他们明白放弃旧术有多么错误！”
他过去一直对旧术持怀疑态度，但现在却希望历代的神话有迹可循，能再现出来。
只是稍微冷静后，他又沉闷地吐了一口气，那一切都不现实，所谓的传说毫无根据。
王煊仰望星空，列仙、神话等在古代是否出现过？
他摇了摇头，即便有确凿的证据表明列仙曾经在世，也不过是给后来者信心而已，但对他来说没有任何意义。
因为，他不信仙佛，研究旧术从来不是因为那些神话，他只是因为自己喜欢探索，想看一看旧术这条路究竟可以走到哪里。

列仙是否存在过，他并不在意，他信念坚定，在以自身验证这条路。
听说今天晚上投月票会乘四倍，太凶残了，双倍都不够看了，有月票的话请大家给《深空彼岸》投下吧。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Abandoned as worn out shoes
Qin Cheng was stunned. It took him a long time and a lot of energy to find out some secrets through his family connections.
But now Wang Xuan has deduced more things through his own observations, and suspects that there is another way to reach supernatural power.
"So, the old technique was abandoned like this?!" Qin Cheng was very unwilling.
When he found out the secrets, he was still very excited, thinking that he finally understood the truth, and that the purpose of studying old techniques was to touch the supernatural power.
It was also at that moment that he strengthened his belief that from now on he would seriously study the old skills and overcome all difficulties on this path.
But now he heard that there seemed to be another way to get close to supernatural power, which immediately poured cold water on his newly heated heart.
It took Qin Cheng a long time to come back to his senses, feeling a little shocked.
What did Xinxing discover? Apart from mysterious phenomena, he also found a true path to transcendence?
Obviously, if true, this will cause unimaginable impact, both conceptually and in some real-world changes.
Qin Cheng was serious and serious: "Right now, the opportunity to go to Xinxing is becoming more and more precious. If you can touch the supernatural power and be at the forefront, everything you think is possible!"
The two chatted and had breakfast.
"The special food transported from deep space is really missing one meal. I thought it tasted terrible at first, but now I feel a little reluctant to part with it."
The two of them were quite emotional.
Although these ingredients are very rare and expensive, the taste is really not that good when combined with various ingredients.
Qin Cheng asked Wang Xuan if he had talked to the old professor who taught them the old skills to see if there was any way to solve the problem of going to Xinxing.
Wang Xuan shook his head. Although the old professor liked him very much, he did not have that much power. In this old art research project, he was only invited to teach the old art and did not participate in anything else.
"What are their criteria for selecting people?" Qin Cheng was dissatisfied and felt that it was unfair to Wang Xuan.
Wang Xuan thought for a while and said: "I guess it has something to do with a keen mind, releasing potential far beyond ordinary people, etc. In short, it just touched the mysterious field a little bit."
He had seen the first list of those selected and made this inference.
For example, there are a pair of twin sisters in the class who often have inexplicable connections with each other. If the younger sister is accidentally frightened, the older sister will also have heart palpitations at the same time.
One time, my sister left a deep bloody cut on her finger while peeling an apple. At that time, my sister was in another city for business. Although they were far apart, the corresponding finger also suffered from pain.
There is no explanation for this phenomenon.
When selecting students for the experimental class this time, the two of them were selected at the first opportunity.
"What happened to He Qing?" Qin Cheng asked puzzledly.
In his impression, He Qing, who was in the experimental class, was introverted and simple, and didn't talk much on weekdays.
It is reported that He Qing was not interested in old skills at first. He signed up after hearing that he could be guaranteed a decent job with a high salary after graduation.
So Qin Cheng couldn't figure it out. He Qing was obviously resistant, so how could he be selected in the end?
"One thing happened to He Qing. When he was fourteen years old, he saw his younger brother was about to be hit by a speeding car. He rushed over desperately and pushed his younger brother away. However, he was run over by the car. However, he was not injured. He only left black marks on his body from being run over by the tires."
At that time, everyone was shocked and a little confused. In the end, they could only think that he had unleashed some mysterious potential of the human body at the critical moment of life and death.
The investors of the old art research project dug up and investigated this incident in He Qing's youth, which shows how deeply they know about them.
The first batch of people selected all have their own special characteristics. For example, there is a girl with extraordinary perception. The most famous experience is that she was so flustered before boarding a plane.Well, I thought I was sick and had a heart problem, so I was so scared that I ran to the doctor temporarily.
As a result, the plane she missed that day crashed.
"Is this possible? There is such a monster in our class!" Qin Cheng was stunned. He had never heard of this before.
Wang Xuan was also a little emotional. He was in a daze when he heard it for the first time, but this girl was the most special, and other people and things were barely acceptable.
On the same day, the list of those selected to go to Xinxing was finally confirmed, and sure enough, no new people were added.
Some people in the experimental class stayed and never gave up, waiting for the last chance. Now that the results are announced, they are extremely disappointed.
Although some people had premonitions, they still felt very uncomfortable.
Wang Xuan was very calm and had already expected this result.
Qin Cheng sighed, feeling sorry for his friend. He really practiced his old skills and became famous, but was abandoned because the supernatural power at the end of deep space revealed the tip of the iceberg and another way appeared!
Xinxing chose Chaoren and officially gave up the old technique!
Qin Cheng and Wang Xuan chatted a lot. When they talked about the few friends in the class who left early, they felt sad for a while.
Fortunately, Wang Xuan stayed in his old land and could reunite with those people.
Qin Cheng asked him: "Aren't you going to meet your girlfriend? She is about to return to Xinxing. If you don't go, there will really be no chance. I'm afraid it will be difficult to see her again in the future."
Wang Xuan shook his head: "We have been separated for more than a year, so I won't send her off, lest her family members know about it and think too much about it, causing trouble to her. Let's all be well."
Qin Cheng sighed. There was an ex-girlfriend from Xinxing who put a lot of pressure on Wang Xuan at the beginning. The girl's family was quite strong and they came directly to the old land to warn her several times.
"You were not selected this time. Could it be that her family members were trying to suppress you and prevent you from going to Xinxing?" Qin Cheng suddenly thought of this possibility.
Because Wang Xuan’s ex-girlfriend’s family is very unusual.
Although the old technique is now abandoned.
But looking back now, some people in the early days sent their children from Xinxing to learn old skills. They were obviously preparing for contact with supernatural powers. There must be some background.
"No!" Although the number of contacts is limited, Wang Xuan understands the personalities of her family members, so it won't be like this. Besides, they have been separated for more than a year, and there is no intersection with them.
In addition, there are some chaebols behind the old technology research project, and no one dares to mess around.
Night fell, the stars were shining, and the two talked about everything.
"I'm going to New Moon in a few days. Wang Xuan, I feel a little conflicted in my heart. I really hope you have the opportunity to go to New Star, get in touch with supernatural power, and embark on that new path. But I also feel that they throw away the old skills and discard them like old shoes. It's too much. We have all been abandoned!"
At this point, Qin Cheng calmed down and spoke again: "So, I somewhat hope that you can make great achievements in the old arts. It would be great if those myths and legends were true. One day you can use the old arts to fight against supernatural forces, suppress the creatures in the extraordinary realm on the new star, and let them understand how wrong it is to give up the old arts!"
He has always been skeptical of old techniques in the past, but now he hopes that the myths of the past dynasties can be traced and reproduced.
After calming down a little, he let out a dull breath. None of that was realistic, and the so-called legend was groundless.
Wang Xuan looked up at the stars. Did immortals, myths, etc. appear in ancient times?
He shook his head. Even if there was conclusive evidence that Immortals were alive, it would only give confidence to those who came after him, but it meant nothing to him.
Because he does not believe in immortals and Buddhas, his study of old arts has never been because of those myths. He just likes to explore and wants to see where the path of old arts can go.
He didn't care whether immortals existed or not. He had a firm belief and was verifying this path with himself.
I heard that voting for the monthly ticket tonight will be multiplied by four times. It’s too cruel. DoubleIt's not enough to watch it twice. If you have a monthly ticket, please vote for "The Other Side of Deep Space".
